title: Option to not wrap st.segmented_control while displaying on a page
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests. - [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue. ### Summary When we have more number of tabs created with st.segemented_control on the mobile devices they wrap and on UI it takes lot of space on page. It should be displayed in the same row as tabs and the user can then scroll it horizontally to use them with this additional flag / option to not wrap it. ### Why? _No response_ ### How? _No response_ ### Additional Context _No response_
